title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy to make surprise Berlin visit this Tuesday, Merz says
summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the Ukrainian president is due to arrive in Germany around midday amid a renewed push for peace talks with Moscow.

image.caption: The US recently confirmed new talks with Russia about ending the conflict [File: October 4, 2025]Image: Dan Bashakov/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy would visit Berlin for talks on Tuesday.
The meeting comes as Kyiv seeks more missiles to defend against Russian ballistic strikes and asks European governments for an additional €70 billion in funding next year.
Merz told Berlin's Chamber of Commerce and Industry that he expected to meet Zelenskyy around midday. The visit had been kept under wraps for security reasons.
What is on the agenda in Berlin?

Military and financial support is expected to be a focus of the talks. Ukraine needs more missiles for systems such as the US-made Patriot. Germany has already supplied the Patriot systems it says it can spare without weakening its own air defenses.
This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
